name: 4ST Prime Core — Telegram Music Userbot
description: Telethon + Pyrogram/PyTgCalls Telegram music userbot with zero-disk streaming, Invidious/Piped/JioSaavn/SoundCloud failover, and live GitHub-backed persistence.

TELEGRAM_API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).

TELEGRAM_API_HASH.description: Telegram API hash from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Bot token for the assistant/menu bot, from @BotFather.

TELEGRAM_PRIMARY_SESSION.description: Telethon session string for the primary/owner userbot account (generate once locally, never share it).

TELEGRAM_PYRO_SESSION.description: Pyrogram session string for the primary/owner account's music engine. Leave blank and set it up later from the bot's Music Setup menu if you don't have one yet.

TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user ID (owner/admin of this bot).

TELEGRAM_OWNER_USERNAME.description: Your Telegram @username (without the @), used for owner-recognition fallback.

TELEGRAM_LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Numeric chat ID of a private channel/group the bot logs deploy/error events to.

TELEGRAM_HELP_LINK.description: A t.me link shown as the 'Help/Report' button (defaults to a placeholder if unset).

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key, used for any AI-assisted bot features.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: A GitHub Personal Access Token (repo scope) used to persist mutable bot data (users, sessions, custom commands, warnings) to a GitHub repo, since Heroku's filesystem is wiped on every restart/deploy.

GITHUB_REPO.description: The 'owner/repo' GitHub repository the bot syncs its data/config.json file to (e.g. yourname/bot-data). Recommended: use a small PRIVATE repo dedicated to this, separate from your bot's source code repo.

GITHUB_CONFIG_PATH.description: Path (inside GITHUB_REPO) where the bot's config.json is stored.
